mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_stat_hourly (stat_hour, slot_code, category_code, cnt, ad_cnt, tot_cost_ms, p99_cost_ms, total_pay_price, total_cost) VALUES (#{statHour}, #{slotCode}, #{categoryCode}, #{cnt}, #{adCnt}, #{totCostMs}, #{p99CostMs}, #{totalPayPrice}, #{totalCost}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cnt = cnt + #{cnt}, ad_cnt = ad_cnt + #{adCnt}, tot_cost_ms = tot_cost_ms + #{totCostMs}, p99_cost_ms = GREATEST(p99_cost_ms, #{p99CostMs}), total_pay_price = total_pay_price + #{totalPayPrice}, total_cost = total_cost + #{totalCost}
